name: Summer Adventures Day Camp
operator_name: Oak Knoll School of the Holy Child
description_short: Day camp on Oak Knoll's Summit campus for children entering grades 1 to 5, 9 to 3:30, with specialists in music, art, sports and tennis, daily swimming at a private pool in New Providence (bused there), and lacrosse and archery for grades 2 to 5. Families choose one to seven weeks.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $100 administrative fee with written notice before April 1; tuition is not refundable after April 1. A $50 fee applies to registrations after May 1.
notes: 2027 prices not posted yet. For reference only, 2026 day camp was $760 per week ($660 for the short July 3 week), or $4,945 to $5,095 for all seven weeks.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Adventures Day Camp: grades 1 to 5, full day 9 to 3:30, one to seven weeks, daily swimming at Jersey Aquatic Center in New Providence by Oak Knoll bus, full lunch in the dining hall. The page states ACA accreditation. Prices on this page are 2026 ($760 per week, $660 for the July 3 week, all seven weeks $4,945 through 3/31/26) and are not recorded as 2027 prices. Ages derived from grades, not stated. Address from the school's calendar entries on the page. Oak Knoll is a Catholic school.

Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027 registration opens January 13, 2027; camp runs June 28 to August 13, 2027. Camp office 908-522-8151. Extended care (no year shown): before care 7:30 to 8:45 $125 per week, after care to 4:30 $100 or to 5:30 $200 per week. Nursery and Kinder Camps, sports, academic and other programs are listed separately.
